what: Veralto makes instruments and consumables for water quality and for product identification. One half tests and treats water for utilities and industry; the other makes the inkjet coding systems and packaging colour software used to mark and label products.
customers: Municipal water utilities, industrial water users, food and beverage manufacturers, and consumer goods packaging operations.
money: water analysis instruments, treatment chemicals and services
marking and coding systems, inks and packaging software
moat: Instruments and printers that run on its own consumables and reagents, generating recurring revenue for the life of each installation.
risks: Growth of about 6% is steady rather than fast
Industrial customers defer instrument purchases in downturns
Debt of about $3 billion from the spin-off from Danaher
opportunities: Gross margin of 60% with a 23% operating margin
Return on invested capital of 17% with cash covering much of its debt
Water testing demand rises with tightening regulation on contaminants
watch: Core revenue growth and the share coming from recurring consumables.
